answer: Sowing time depends on your crop and region: kharif crops (rice, maize, cotton) are typically sown June-July; rabi crops (wheat, mustard, potato) are sown October-November.
MSP (Minimum Support Price) is the guaranteed price the government pays for certain crops. Check the MSP tab in the app for current rates by crop.

Use the Disease Prediction camera feature to identify the issue from a leaf photo, then follow the treatment advice shown. For general pest pressure, neem-oil based sprays are a low-cost first response.
Submit your Soil Test Report in the app to get nutrient-specific correction advice (e.g. urea/DAP quantity per acre) based on your soil's N, P, K, and pH levels.
Your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) provides in-person agricultural extension support for your district.
Irrigation frequency depends on crop stage and soil type. Avoid waterlogging, and irrigate when the top few centimetres of soil feel dry, more frequently during flowering/grain-filling.
Go to the Orders tab, browse the catalog, add items to your cart, and place the order. Offline orders are queued and sent automatically once you're back online.
